name: Bahar
description: Bahar gave up her medical career to be a devoted wife and mother — and got two decades of being taken for granted in return. When a sudden illness brings her face to face with death, she discovers just how little her "perfect" family values her. Surviving against the odds and finally opening her eyes, Bahar sets out to reclaim the life she sacrificed — returning to medicine, confronting her husband's secrets and rediscovering herself. A warm, funny and deeply satisfying story of a woman finally blooming.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
Bahar graduated from medical school twenty years ago and chose to be a housewife instead of a doctor. Bahar is married to successful surgeon Timur Yavuzoğlu and devotes her life to her husband and children. The Yavuzoğlu family, which looks very happy from the outside, is shaken by Bahar's illness. Bahar's doctor Evren is determined to save her and tells her that the only way out is a liver transplant. Only Timur's liver is compatible!

Nothing will ever be the same for the Yavuzoğlu family, who are tested with a great threshold!

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Bahar, who leaves her illness behind and is reborn, now has a new life ahead of her. When Bahar is discharged from the hospital and returns home, Nevra and Timur greet her with a big "get well soon" celebration. However, Bahar's speech at this celebration and her change afterwards make Timur and Nevra uneasy. No one can guess what is going through Bahar's mind and what she plans to do. She is determined to shake all the balances with the big decision she will take about her life. Bahar's biggest supporter will be Evren. At the same time, traces of the past are revealed in the Bahar-Timur-Rengin triangle. In the finale, Bahar's new decision will shake everyone.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bahar's admission to the hospital is a shock for Timur. Now Bahar, Timur and Aziz Uras are in the same hospital. Even though they work here as a family, they decide to hide their family relationship. Timur and Rengin start making plans to send Bahar away. Evren will be the person who will support Bahar at the hospital and help her the most. On the other hand, Bahar tries to get used to the dual life of being an assistant doctor at the hospital and a mother at home. Nevra, on the other hand, accuses Bahar of being a bad mother and continues to be hard on her. Bahar's first shift at the hospital coincides with Umay's birthday, which causes tension in the family to increase. A bad event that will happen to Umay causes Bahar to question her decision again.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Bahar takes a step towards a new beginning, the whole family is shaken by the news of Umay's hospitalization. While there is a showdown within the Yavuzoğlu family, Cihan Taşkeski arrives at the hospital and confronts Evren and Timur. Cihan's arrival is also a new test for Bahar. While Bahar tries to fix the problems between her and Umay, a big surprise awaits Timur at home. Parla! Bahar, who catches Timur's vulnerability, will continue to struggle in his new hospital adventure while being tested by his suspicion.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Bahar's misfortune while intervening with Mr. Cihan worries Timur. Therefore, Timur and Rengin, whose ties between them have been strained by the bracelet issue, will face a new test. On the other hand, Reha, who holds Bahar responsible for the leak of Cihan Bey's images to the press, gives her one last chance. Timur and Evren are forced to work together for Cihan's surgery. On the other hand, another case Zarife arrives at the hospital and drags Bahar into an inextricable situation. Aziz Uras, whose relationship with both Seren and Doruk is tested with Bahar's arrival at the hospital, makes a move that surprises everyone. With this move of Aziz Uras, Bahar will be on the verge of a very difficult decision...

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Bahar is determined to resign, Cihan Taşkeski changes the whole situation! While Timur and Rengin are disappointed, Parla hides a truth in Umay's bag that will turn them all upside down! As Rengin and Timur try to thwart Parla's plans, a bomb is dropped at the hospital that Rengin struggles to escape. Her father Tahsin! Bahar tries to help her patients and Rengin at the same time. Aziz Uras talks to both Evren and Timur in order to resolve the tension with Doruk and Seren. Timur questions his own fatherhood and recalls his relationship with his father. The painful event that brings Timur, Parla and Rengin together will cause a new deadlock.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Rengin is devastated by the loss of her father. Evren sees Timur hugging her and begins to suspect their relationship. As Rengin tries to pull herself together, she misses a very important detail about her patient, and Bahar sacrifices herself to protect her. Umay and Parla meet Rüzgar and a new adventure begins for both of them. Selim doesn't want to hide what he knows anymore and decides to talk to Parla, Rengin sets out to prevent Selim and Parla from talking, a big surprise awaits Bahar who is unaware of all these complicated relationships!

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Parla wants to talk to Rengin, even though she doesn't believe what Selim told her, and is devastated by the news that Rengin had an accident. Seeing Timur's concern for Rengin at the hospital, Bahar becomes suspicious and prepares to confront Timur while supporting and bonding with Parla. Timur tries to keep everything in balance but fails. Evren forms a close bond with Parla, and with this bond, the veil of mystery in Evren's past is lifted. A surprise guest changes all the balances and Bahar faces a great danger!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Timur and Rengin are approaching the inevitable end. Timur comes to the point of confessing everything to Bahar. Therefore, Rengin finds herself on the brink of new and big decisions. Bahar's health condition worsens in the predicament of the doubt she is experiencing. Her close circle rolls up their sleeves to support Bahar. A new patient diagnosed with organ failure arouses very familiar feelings in Bahar. Helping this patient becomes a personal matter for Bahar. Bahar will find the support she seeks in women's solidarity. Timur tries to cover up the truth, but his secret gradually spreads. Rengin's pressure leads Timur towards an inevitable end. During the ball organized to collect donations for the hospital, a big truth will be revealed.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Timur and Bahar's relationship is learned by everyone. Rengin tries to do the right thing for herself and Parla with her disappointment. Evren gets under a heavy burden thanks to the film crew coming to the hospital, decides to lift this burden for Bahar and warns Timur. The film crew witnesses strange moments at the hospital. While Timur tries to find a balance with his family, Bahar prepares a big surprise for everyone!

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Bahar confronts Timur and Rengin. After this big confrontation, she gets involved in the hospital's volunteer work while planning the steps she will take for her new life. All members of the Peran Foundation Hospital set off for volunteer work in Şavklı Village. One day in the village brings big surprises for everyone. Rengin, who cannot handle Timur's desire to reconcile with Bahar, has other plans for Bahar!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Bahar is determined to part ways with Timur, but it won't be as easy as she thinks! An incident that happens to Nevra forces Timur and Bahar to come together! On the other hand, Umay and Aziz Uras try to cope with the disintegration of their order.  Aziz Uras makes a wrong decision about Zeynep. This decision keeps the Yavuzoğlu Family together. Timur has to protect Aziz Uras while dealing with Selim. Bahar is on the verge of an important decision...

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Seren falls ill in the middle of the celebration and everyone learns about her pregnancy. After Seren shares her reservations about her family with Bahar, Bahar goes to meet Seren's mother. Seren's mother Efsun, an extremely difficult character, will open another front for Bahar to fight. Timur helps Bahar plan a romantic proposal for Aziz Uras and Seren, while trying to find money for the mortgage debt on the house. On the night of Aziz Uras' proposal, Bahar gathers her courage and plans to have dinner with Evren for the first time, but unexpected events await her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Rengin's purchase of Bahar's house not only upsets all the balances in the family, but also causes a major incident. While Seren and Bahar struggle with the impact of this big event, Rengin's mistake causes Bahar to become infuriated.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Bahar is shattered by Evren's shooting and her life is turned upside down when she is suspended from the hospital. While Timur tries to save Evren, Süreyya deals the final blow to Bahar. The identity of the young patient who dropped into the hospital like a bomb causes curiosity among the assistants and doctors. Efsun is busy confusing Seren and Aziz Uras by taking advantage of this confusion. Having lost her job, her home and Evren, Bahar is determined to be reborn from the ashes. But a bitter surprise awaits her in the finale.
